2021 Q2.gq: We dramatically raised guidance for the full-year 2021, and we now expect to achieve sustainable adjusted EBITDA profitability in 2022.
2021 Q2.bq: The strength, breadth and persistence of these results showed momentum that exceeded our expectations, coming in well ahead of our financial guidance on both revenue and adjusted EBITDA.

2021 Q3.gq: For the fourth quarter, we expect revenue of $1.575 billion to $1.625 billion.
2021 Q3.bq: On the financial side, we posted record third quarter revenue of nearly $1.75 billion, up 47% year over year and at the high end of our guidance.

2021 Q4.bq: We are proud of our 2021 results, and we exceeded our expectations.

2022 Q1.bq: We beat the upper end of our first quarter revenue guidance by generating $1.4 billion in revenue.

2022 Q2.gq: Given the market uncertainty, we are lowering our outlook for the full year 2022 to $6.15 billion to $6.45 billion, which represents revenue growth of negative 4% to positive 0.5% for the full year.

2022 Q3.gq: For Q4 of this year, we expect revenue of $1.15 billion to $1.3 billion, which is a reduction to the implied Q4 guidance we provided in August.
2022 Q3.bq: Third quarter revenue was $1.49 billion, coming in at the high end of our revenue guidance range of $1.4 billion to $1.5 billion.

2022 Q4.gq: For Q1 of 2023, we expect revenue in the range of $850 million to $950 million, and adjusted EBITDA of negative $90 million to negative $70 million.
2022 Q4.bq: Fourth quarter revenue was $1.11 billion, coming in below our revenue guidance range of $1.15 billion to $1.13 billion.

2023 Q1.gq: For Q2 of 2023, we expect revenue in the range of $1.45 billion to $1.6 billion and positive adjusted EBITDA of $30 million to $50 million.
2023 Q1.bq: We achieved strong financial results for Q1 2023 and revenue and adjusted EBITDA were better than both our guidance and consensus estimates.

2023 Q2.gq: For Q3 of 2023, we expect revenue in the range of $1.3 billion to $1.4 billion and positive adjusted EBITDA of $15 million to $35 million.

2023 Q3.bq: Our third-quarter revenue was 1.34 billion, falling slightly below the midpoint of our guidance range of 1.3 billion to 1.4 billion, reflecting pressure from mortgage rates that have continued to rise since the time we put out our Q3 guidance back in August.

2024 Q1.gq: For Q2 of 2024, we expect revenue in the range of $1.6 billion to $1.7 billion, and we expect adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $55 million to $75 million.
2024 Q1.bq: Our adjusted EBITDA for the first quarter was a negative $20.1 million, which was slightly better than the favorable end of our guidance range of a negative $22 million to negative $40 million, and an improvement of 70% over the adjusted EBITDA loss of $67 million a year ago.

2024 Q2.gq: For Q3 of 2024, we expect revenue in the range of $1.425 billion to $1.525 billion, and we expect adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $30 million to $50 million.
2024 Q2.bq: Our second-quarter revenue was $1.7 billion, an increase of 14% from the year ago period, which was at the high end of our guidance range of $1.6 billion to $1.7 billion.

2024 Q3.gq: For Q4 of 2024, we expect revenue in the range of $1.225 billion to $1.325 billion, and we expect adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $0 to positive $10 million.
2024 Q3.bq: Our third quarter revenue was $1.5 billion, an increase of 11.7% from the year-ago period, which was toward the high end of our guidance range of $1.425 billion to $1.525 billion. 5.3% of this revenue growth is attributed to organic growth, while 6.4% came from M&A.

2026 Q2.bq: Revenue in Q2 reached $4.3 billion, which exceeded the high end of our revenue guidance range of $4 billion to $4.2 billion.
